title: Settings
helper: Manage your local agent, daemon connection, and setup options from one place.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.helper: View or change where Nexus stores your creative files on this machine.
workspace.browserOnly: Workspace path changes are available on the desktop app only.
workspace.savedHonesty: Workspace path saved. Restart or reload the app so the running daemon uses the new location.

agent.title: Agent
agent.helper: Choose which local ACP agent Nexus uses for creative work.
agent.browserOnly: Agent selection is available on the desktop app only.
agent.scanError: The daemon did not respond to the agent scan request.

connection.title: Connect to Daemon
connection.description: Enter the remote daemon URL and API key. Local mode remains available — you can revert here at any time.
connection.urlHelper: The full HTTPS address of the daemon, including port.
connection.apiKeyPlaceholder: Enter the API key from the daemon machine
connection.apiKeyHelper: The API key from the daemon machine ({{command}} on that host).
connection.loopback: This daemon has no TLS certificate. It is running in loopback-only mode, so remote access is not available. Use local mode instead.
connection.fingerprintTrust: Confirm the certificate fingerprint matches what you see on the daemon machine before connecting.
connection.fingerprintTrustDescription: This fingerprint is how your app makes sure it is talking to the real daemon and not someone pretending to be it. Compare it to the value printed on the daemon machine's screen. If they match, it is safe to trust.
connection.fingerprintMismatch: The certificate for this daemon has changed. This can happen if the daemon was reinstalled or its certificate was deliberately rotated. It can also mean someone is intercepting your connection.
connection.trustNewCertificate: Trust the New Certificate and Continue
connection.keepOldCertificate: Cancel and Keep Using the Old Certificate
connection.originNote: If you are connecting from a browser tab to a remote daemon, your serving origin must be listed in the daemon's {{setting}} setting. Desktop apps are allowed automatically.
connection.fingerprintError: Browsers cannot reliably distinguish an unreachable daemon from a rejected self-signed certificate, so fetching the certificate fingerprint may fail even when the daemon is running. For remote daemons that use a self-signed certificate, use the Nexus desktop app — it supports Trust On First Use (TOFU) and can store the certificate in the OS keychain.
